rule:
fl23: bounded direct fence admission (L2) on top of grouped archive fsyncs (FG) vs FG alone. Beads br-9ott5 (reservations fail
under swarm load) and br-kp1in.19. Written 2026-10-21 ~23:10Z by CopperGoose, while both arms build and before any fl23 run. It gets
a FROZEN line with both sha256s before its first run.

DISCLOSED CONTEXT. Everything below was seen before this rule.
- fg22b (FG vs main 2b5d14d7 + br-tsqvm; frozen rule fg22_rule.txt; LOSS on its P2 completion guard 1.06x; FG lands by the user's
  decision recorded there). Per-run reservation errors per 1,000 file_reservation_paths calls:
  P2 base 919.5 / 924.4, FG 906.6 / 929.4; P6 base 783.3 / 748.3, FG 518.1 / 506.8. P6 reservation p99 base 1.28 / 0.90 s,
  FG 0.33 / 0.35 s. P2 drain rate base 21.35, FG 30.30 ops/s (pooled); archive gap at swarm end base ~4,050, FG ~40.
- rg21 (L2 alone vs main, LOSS): P2 errors 934 -> 704 per 1,000, P6 790 -> 340; reserve p99 rose to 1.7 s. Fence holds outlasted
  the 500 ms budget even at P6.
- ab18 (SP + L2 + L3): P6 errors 766 -> 2.3 per 1,000; P2 929 -> 296; LOSS on completion 1.12x and soak convergence.
- Reconciler: a visit for a WBQ-written, uncommitted message costs O(project history) under the fence (scratch timing, test build:
  0.1-0.2 s at 250 committed messages up to ~5.5 s at 5,000). With FG the archive stays current, so fewer visits take that path.

LEVER: L2 = l2_on_main_v1.patch (storage lib.rs only): admit_direct_publication retries the zero-wait direct fence admission with
a doubling pause of at most 10 ms for up to 500 ms, checking cancellation each attempt; plus its 3 unit tests (short hold waited
out, stalled holder refused within the budget, cancellation) and its planted negative (budget 0 -> the short-hold and
cancellation tests fail; recorded 2026-10-21 for rg21).

ARMS (portable release, same host, host lock):
- base = build36/fl23_base/am, from rc1021i = main 4d1f5c82 + fg_v2.patch (crates diff 4d5f959c1cb4, the tree FG lands as).
- cand = build36/fl23_cand/am, from rc1021h = the same + l2_on_main_v1.patch (crates diff b6c6e389bdf6).
Both build logs must show those diff hashes; both sha256s are recorded at freeze.

RUNS: P6 (60 agents, period 6 s, 300 s): cand base base cand cand base. P2 (period 2 s): base cand cand base. Then the release
smoke in both orders from rc1020f. Validity as fg22b: start when the 1-min load < 8; a run overlapping a foreign >400% CPU process
or with / below 2 GB free is invalid and re-queued; pre-run disk guard < 8 GB stops the series (remaining runs not run; a verdict
missing primary data is INCONCLUSIVE); 6 h deadline.

PRIMARY (both must hold):
- M1 (the br-9ott5 probe below saturation): pooled valid P6 cand file_reservation_paths errors <= 10 per 1,000 calls.
- M2 (relief at saturation): pooled valid P2 cand reservation error rate <= 50% of base's.

GUARDS (any failure = LOSS):
- G1: P2 completion median cand <= 1.05x base (equal archive work: both arms keep the archive current); smoke swarm acked sends
  cand >= 0.95x base in each order.
- G2: non-reservation paced tool errors cand <= base + 5 (P2 and P6 pooled); smoke tool errors cand <= base + 5 per order; cand
  crash phase PASS in each order; integrity_check ok; no canonical-id collision errors in any cand log; smoke dispatch zombies cand
  == 0 or <= base's per order (L2 waits on request threads, GH#351's symptom).
- G3: P6 send p99 cand <= 1.2x base; P6 file_reservation_paths p99 and release p99 cand <= base + 0.5 s; every P6 completion
  <= 330 s.
- G4: P2 mean archive gap at swarm end cand <= base + 100; smoke soak "archive converges after load stops" must not pass for base
  and fail for cand in either order.
- C, on current main (with FG) + L2: storage lib nextest (only br-3ukrb's and br-u5biy's tests may fail, and only as on base);
  storage + tools clippy -D warnings; workspace --lib --bins check; tools it; conformance; the L2 planted negative.

REPORTED, not gated: the br-9ott5 probe at P2; reservation p50; send p50/p90 (closed-loop caveat); drain rate; reconciler
verified/deferred counters.

DECISION:
- WIN only if M1, M2, G1-G4 and C hold. A WIN lands L2 (storage lib.rs; mine) with this rule and the evidence cited.
  br-9ott5 closes only if its own probe passes at P2 and P6.
- LOSS: one line on br-9ott5 and br-kp1in.19; the patch goes beside the receipt; nothing lands.
